name: Departure Board
description: The next departures from one of your stops, with their routes, live or timetable times and any service alert. The stops and the key are the transit provider's (Transitland's settings, My Stops). Not a real-time display: it says how old its times are, and leaves out what you could no longer catch.

properties.name: stop
properties.title: Stop
properties.description: One of My Stops (Transitland settings). Its walk time decides which departures are still worth showing.

properties.name: rows
properties.title: Departures
properties.description: How many departures the board shows at most.

properties.name: title
properties.title: Title
properties.description: The heading above the board. Empty: the stop's name.

properties.name: fontSize
properties.title: Text Size
properties.description: The size of the text on the page.
